# Fixture provenance

`speech.wav` is derived by resampling `tests/samples/sample.wav` from
[`nkeenan38/voice_activity_detector`](https://github.com/nkeenan38/voice_activity_detector),
commit `e12369f9d7849a020f33a32dd452a6abb06804d3`, which is MIT licensed
(Copyright 2024 Nicholas Keenan). The source license applies to that fixture.

`silence.wav` is two seconds of generated 16 kHz mono PCM silence.
`quiet.wav` is two seconds of generated 16 kHz mono PCM 220 Hz tone at 0.01%
full scale. They are project-generated test data.
